note: The project ALREADY has a WPF StatusBar (Views/PurchaseOrderLinesView.xaml lines 175-229) with message/counts/selection/errors/unsaved/hidden-columns + key hints + totals, styled by Bar.Status* in Themes/Controls.xaml. The correct implementation is to EXTEND that bar with two new segments (last sync time, failed postings) reusing Bar.Status.Sep / Bar.Status.Text / Btn.Status.Link, not to build a second bar. process.reuse_first is therefore critical. Failed postings must not be colour-only (a11y.color_not_only) and the sync timestamp must be absolute+relative and never a bare 'synced' (data.refresh_timestamp / state.offline_sync).
